notes: Four STL files for centring and seating the rear main seal flush or 1 mm recessed. This is a workshop tool, not an installed vehicle part; dimensional and procedural validation remains mandatory. 2026-10-15: the original Thingiverse page (thing 2006970) was not read: www.thingiverse.com served its robots.txt behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403, 'Just a moment...') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client, so permission for automated agents could not be established and the thing page was not requested. The Internet Archive index lists a capture of that page dated 2017-04-24 (HTTP 200); it was not read, because the page-reading tool refuses web.archive.org. The CC-BY-SA (no version) statement rests only on the secondary archive, so redistribution is set to unknown, as for every Renn 3D Parts record, until the licence is read on the original page. 2026-11-05 (owner decision: Internet Archive captures count as provenance evidence): the Wayback capture https://web.archive.org/web/20170424143508/http://www.thingiverse.com:80/thing:2006970 (raw HTML, 101,191 bytes, SHA-256 in docs/research/public-3d-asset-archive-licence-pass-2026-11-05.md) was read with a plain HTTP client. It states 'Porsche 911 rear main seal tool by stagsimon is licensed under the Creative Commons - Attribution - Share Alike license', linked to creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. This agrees with the Renn 3D Parts declaration and fixes the version, so the licence is archive-verified as CC-BY-SA-3.0; redistribution is attribution_required and derivatives must be shared alike.
